content.question: Match key structures of transformers with their features.

answer.Self-attention mechanism: Lets every token attend to all other tokens in the sequence, computing a relevance-weighted combination of their values.
answer.Encoder-decoder network: The overall architecture: one stack builds a representation of the input sequence, and a second stack generates the output sequence, linked by cross-attention.
answer.Multi-head attention: Runs several attention computations in parallel, each with its own learned projections, so different heads can capture different kinds of relationships.
answer.Positional encoding: Injects information about token order into the input embeddings, since attention by itself has no notion of sequence position.
answer.Feedforward neural network: A position-wise two-layer MLP applied to each token independently, first expanding and then projecting back the dimensionality.
answer.Normalization layers: Stabilize and speed up training by rescaling the activations within each sublayer, keeping their values in a consistent range.
answer.Residual connections: Add each sublayer's input to its output, allowing gradients to flow directly through the network and making very deep stacks trainable.
